children: Overview
France AI Order-to-Cash firm's H1 2026 revenue rose 19%, subscriptions up 23%
EBIT for H1 2026 rose 22%, net income up 15%
Record H1 bookings, with new ARR up 112% and longer contract terms
Outlook
Company expects strong H1 2026 bookings to drive revenue growth from Q4 2026 and into 2027
Sidetrade maintains target of over 50% of revenue from AI-native products by 2030
Company sees North America as a key driver of future revenue growth
Result Drivers
RECORD BOOKINGS - Co said H1 2026 saw €5.16 mln in new annual recurring subscriptions, up 112%, with longer contract terms and more new customers
AI-NATIVE PRODUCTS - Co said launch of new AI-native offerings contributed €1.02 mln in new ARR in Q2, representing 33% of new ARR signed
OPERATING LEVERAGE - Co said improved profitability was driven by cost discipline and operating efficiency, including €1 mln reduction in operating expenses
